---
title: "Step 14: Attach palm rests"
description: Drop the palm rest into the sled and clamp it with set screws, with optional shims for height.
sidebar:
  order: 16
---

The palm rest drops into the sled. M2 thread-cutting screws clamp it at the sides.

Don't overtighten these screws.

![A palm rest seated in its sled on the base plate.](../../../assets/build/palm-rest-on-sled.webp)

## Optional 5 mm shims

The palm rest stands on three legs. You can shim it to any height you like. The holes line up for 0 mm and 5 mm of lift with the default shims.

- If you plan to add padding on top of the palm rest, you'll probably want the low position.
- Adhesive memory foam (1/4 inch) or adhesive-backed leather both work as padding. Foam is less durable.
- The fixing screws are the 4 mm M2 thread-cutting screws, the same as for the PCBAs.

![Exploded view of the palm rest, its three legs, the shims and the fixing screws in the sled.](../../../assets/build/palm-rest-shims.webp)
